notes:
USAGE:
{捕食|ほしょく} is a scientific/ecological term primarily used in biology and nature documentaries. It is not used for human eating. The word appears frequently in discussions of food chains and animal behavior.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {捕食|ほしょく}{者|しゃ}: predator
- {捕食|ほしょく}⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: predatory behavior
- {捕食|ほしょく}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: predator-prey relationship
- ⟦{天敵|てんてき}→天敵：15846_tenteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{捕食|ほしょく}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be preyed upon by a natural enemy
